title: Focusing Light on One Part of the Painting
content: Olana is the Hudson Valley home of 19th century landscape painterFrederic Church(1826-1900) (Link to YouTube video)My goal in this plein-air gouache/watercolor study is to focus light on one part of the painting.Frederic Church himself inspires me to try this kind of lighting, given that he distributes the light in his paintings in a theatrical way.Frederic Church designed his home, inspired by his travels in the Holy Land.-----Frederic Churchon WikipediaGlories of the Hudson: Frederic Edwin Church's Views from Olana (The Olana Collection)Frederic Church: The Art and Science of Detail
